changes.old: Close shot a worried householder looking from a garden pit toward packed household crates, muted evening light. Mid-seventeenth-century English setting: working-age figures in neckcloths and bodices; plaster or oak only where such materials fit the shot, with no East Asian robes
changes.new: Waist-down medium shot of two adult English men in 1660s wool doublets, knee breeches and linen cuffs digging an open pit in loose soil of a walled English garden. Their full-size adult torsos and hands grip two complete wooden-handled iron spades; faces are outside the frame. Evening in 1666, distant brick garden wall.
